gazettes.title: The Princes Convene
gazettes.excerpt: Seven seats were occupied shortly after midnight. No statement was issued when the meeting ended, though the lights in the old council tower remained burning until dawn.

gazettes.title: The Aorta Disappearances
gazettes.excerpt: Three workers vanished beneath the municipal pressure tunnels. Their lamps were found still burning beside a locked service door.

gazettes.title: The Night Register
gazettes.excerpt: The Assembly's published register lists forty-two guests. Three accounts describe a forty-third place at the high table.

gazettes.title: The Iron Choir
gazettes.excerpt: Residents describe a chorus beneath the factory floor. The company says the building has been empty for eleven years.

gazettes.title: The Astral Review
gazettes.excerpt: For seventeen minutes, witnesses saw a pale disc above the chimneys. It appeared in wet glass and polished metal, but not in the sky.

gazettes.title: The Sunday Supplement
gazettes.excerpt: A practical guide to Heartwell's public rooms, private clubs and the streets best avoided after the last tram.
